name: local-resource-manager
description: 本地资源管理器：统一管理图片/视频，元数据自建抓取，内置下载

scripts.scrape:install: python -m venv apps/scrape-service/.venv && apps/scrape-service/.venv/Scripts/pip install -r apps/scrape-service/requirements.txt
scripts.download:install: python -m venv apps/download-service/.venv && apps/download-service/.venv/Scripts/pip install -r apps/download-service/requirements.txt
